signIn.title: Sign in

subtitle.owner: Console for building owners and managers

signIn.phoneHint: We will text you a 6-digit code
signIn.totpHint: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code
signIn.invitation: You are joining a tenant with an invitation
signIn.createAccount: Sign up free as a house or condo owner

enrol.title: Set up two-step verification
enrol.body: Platform accounts need an authenticator app. Scan the QR code with the app (Google Authenticator, 1Password…) and enter the first 6-digit code.
enrol.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
enrol.secret: Or enter this secret in the app
enrol.secretWarning: The secret is shown once. Never share it.

tenantPicker.title: Choose a tenant
tenantPicker.body: Your account belongs to several tenants. Choose the one to work in now; you can switch any time from the top bar.

errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a 10-digit Thai mobile number, e.g. 0812345678
errors.otpInvalid: Wrong code. {count, plural, =0 {Request a new code} one {# attempt left} other {# attempts left}}
errors.otpExpired: The code has expired. Request a new one
errors.otpAttemptsExceeded: Too many wrong codes. Request a new one
errors.otpRateLimited: Too many codes requested. Wait a moment and try again
errors.accountLocked: The account is locked for a while after too many failed attempts
errors.accountDisabled: This account is disabled. Contact the owner or an administrator
errors.noAccess: This account has no access to this part yet
errors.totpInvalid: Wrong authenticator code. Use the latest one
errors.invitationNotPending: This invitation was already used or has expired
errors.tenantNotInScope: You no longer belong to this tenant
errors.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again
errors.generic: Could not sign in. Try again

signUp.title: Create your getproperty account
signUp.subtitle: For owners who rent out a house, townhouse or condo unit themselves. Free, no invitation needed.
signUp.name: Name your tenants will see
signUp.nameHint: Your name or your company's, used on leases and receipts. You can change it later.
signUp.terms: By signing up you accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

errors.cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. Try again or use your phone number.
errors.expired: The sign-in timed out or was opened in another window. Please start again.
errors.failed: The provider could not confirm your account. Please try again.
errors.unavailable: This sign-in is not available yet. Use your phone number instead.
errors.notLinked: This account is not linked to getproperty yet. Sign in with your phone number first, then add it in Settings › Ways to sign in.
errors.emailInUse: This e-mail already has a getproperty account. Sign in the way you did before, then add this method in settings.
errors.contactRequired: This account did not share an e-mail address. Please sign up with your phone number instead.
errors.inUse: This account is already linked to another getproperty user.
errors.noAccess: This account has no access to the console yet.
errors.disabled: This account is disabled. Contact the owner or an administrator.
errors.signInAgain: Please sign in again and retry.
